{{Top|leg}}
'''Stun strips''' were electrified components that could deliver a variable-intensity [[Stun/Legends|stun]] charge upon contact. The [[SE-Vigilant automated sensor beacon]] had stun strips built into its base to deter wildlife from investigating the [[Sensor beacon/Legends|sensor beacon]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
